descriptions.w3d_d31g_free_camera_update_80072534: Free camera update: input word bits 27/26 turn yaw at rate +80, bits 24/25 turn pitch when 0x80178d1c on +92 is set; forward is (sin yaw, sin pitch, cos yaw), right is (-cos yaw, literal, sin yaw), up at +28 is their cross product; bits 28/29 and 31/30 move +4 along forward and right by +76 times dt, bits 24/25 along up when the mode is off; the look point at +16 is position plus forward.
